one_liner: Hot-blooded martial artist of the Kongo Yaegaki school who must master her inner 'raging fire'.
personality: Stoic, intensely courteous and earnest, a practitioner of her grandfather's martial art who treats racing, training and even dancing as budo practice. Underneath she has a fierce temper (烈火) that she is learning to control with a calm 'still water' mind (止水); uniting the two is her goal (火水合一). She reveres her trainer as her master (師), constantly calls herself immature, and has a soft spot for cute, small things she feels she must protect, which flusters her.

speech.register: Stiff samurai/martial-artist register: polite keigo mixed with archaic, bushido-style vocabulary and yojijukugo (four-character idioms such as 乾坤一擲, 心頭滅却)

story_arc.summary: Yaeno joins Tracen to prove her family's Kongo Yaegaki martial art through racing, but she struggles to control her own fiery temper. Under her trainer, whom she treats as a master, she pursues the Satsuki Sho, Derby, Kikuka Sho and senior races toward the ideal of 火水合一, the union of fire and still water. Her later chapters are built around the virtues 義・礼・智・仁・信 and her rivalry with Oguri Cap's 'monster' generation. The real horse won the 1988 Satsuki Sho and the 1990 Tenno Sho (Autumn).
story_arc.source: event titles + web: https://umamusu.wiki/Yaeno_Muteki + general knowledge (unverified for the real-horse record)
